issue_context.title: Add support for footnotes in osu!wiki articles
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Required for correct display of the ["Upgrading to lazer" article](https://osu.ppy.sh/wiki/en/Help_centre/Upgrading_to_lazer) in client.

### Screenshots or videos

![osu_2022-12-16_16-15-58](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/208129507-329528e0-560b-4244-aedd-8af6a6c50e78.jpg)


### Version

current master

### Logs

n/a

review_comments: Cached for two purposes: being able to pull out a fragment of the markdown document for the tooltip, as well for the sake of document navigation.
I'm usually the first one to cry wolf at `.ChildrenOfType<>()` usage outside tests, but let's face it, there is no conceivable simple way to implement this sort of navigation otherwise.

Contents of a tooltip in markdown are themselves... markdown documents. So for correct display I had to cheat a little bit here. This is responsible for cutting out the part of the root document that should be displayed in a separate markdown container placed in the tooltip.

This doesn't match web, but web has constraints and requirements that are way too complicated to make happen here (min width 50px, max width 280px, content vertically centred). This is intended to be best-effort.
Pretty unfortunate with this one, but I guess it's better than nothing for now.
